### Round 2
All six round-1 trials scored 0 on dev and in training, as did the starting net. Each ran on one seed, so this is weak evidence. It points away from these deviations: the simple 4-layout and full 16-layout action orders (8 grid symmetries times type-major or type-minor), anchors within 2 cells, DONE at index 0, obs flipped or transposed relative to the actions, and a learned dense remap. The 16-layout hedge also covers any obs flip or transpose relative to the actions, so obs symmetry views are redundant.

Still untested: a placement count other than T*Y*X (for example, only in-grid anchors). If it differs, every round-1 net fell back to a slow dense head, which would explain the uniform zeros. Also untested: obs memory-layout reinterpretation, wrap-around or non-local dynamics, footprint-pooled features combined with mask inputs, and sample-limited learning.

Every candidate now matches action layouts generically: 16 full-grid layouts, compact-anchor layouts, and a dense fallback. Each then adds one bet, and two kitchen-sink nets try to escape zero first.

### Round 3
After 12 trials, dev and training success are both exactly 0, so the deviation is still unfound. Parameter counts confirm the spec: T=4, an 8x8 grid, Z=6, n_place=256 and n_actions=257, so a wrong action count or grid size is ruled out. The 1x1 stem absorbs any reordering of obs channels, so permuted channels are ruled out for every net. The results also rule out these deviations: the 16 action-layout symmetries, DONE first or last, the obs flipped or transposed as a whole, channel-last memory reads, anchor shifts of 1-2 cells, wrap-around edges, and dense mask remaps that are not shared. Sample counts of 150-260k steps with 1 or 2 PPO epochs also stayed at 0. Still untested: rotations of single channels; cell scrambles that a shared P×P remap could learn; obs scale (handled by LayerNorm after the stem conv); value loss swamping the policy (separate critic, long horizon); dynamics that act over long distances (dilated convs); and height reasoning that shares weights across layers. Each is a separate bet, and one candidate combines them.

### Round 4
All 18 trials scored 0 on dev and in training, so none of them shows which way to go. Since every result is 0, these hedges are ruled out as the fix, either alone or combined:
- action layouts: 16 full layouts, compact anchors, and DONE first or last;
- obs frame: 8 grid symmetries, channel-last re-reads, and learned cell remaps;
- obs scale (LayerNorm);
- wrap-around grids and long-range context (dilations, broadcast);
- footprint pools;
- per-layer encoding;
- a separate critic;
- 1 to 2 PPO epochs, up to 426k steps, and gamma 0.9 to 0.99.

A 1x1 stem already absorbs permuted obs channels. What remains untested:
- arbitrary pairings between cells or actions, learned by global attention with learned positions, or by a direct MLP from the flat obs and mask to the logits;
- a mask that is corrupt or misleading;
- a world that is valid but harder, needing more capacity, larger batches or standard PPO initialisation;

This is the last round, so I am spending it on diverse bets. Any nonzero score beats the starting architecture.
